Accordion.purpose: A header that shows and hides the content under it.

Avatar.purpose: An image, or initials on a neutral circle.

AvatarGroup.purpose: Overlapping stack of avatars with a limit and an overflow count

Banner.purpose: A full-width strip on the brand's solid colour, for a notice above a screen.

BarChart.purpose: A bar per series for each row of `data`, grouped by the x value, on a card with a header, a legend and tick labels.

BlockQuote.purpose: A large quote between short rules, with who said it and where.

Breadcrumbs.purpose: Where the current screen sits, as a trail of links that wraps onto more lines when it is longer than the screen is wide.

Button.purpose: Action button with variants, sizes, prefix/suffix icons and a loading state; onPress runs it

Card.purpose: Pressable surface (onPress), with every Flex prop; a static panel is a Column with background, border and radius instead

Checkbox.purpose: Checkbox with label and description, including an indeterminate state

CodeBlock.purpose: One or more snippets, with tabs between them, a copy button, line numbers and highlighted lines, coloured by a small built-in tokenizer in place of Prism.

Column.purpose: Vertical flex layout — default direction column

ContextMenu.purpose: A long press on `children` opens a menu at the press point, the phone's right-click.

DateInput.purpose: An `Input`-styled field showing the date, that opens a `DatePicker` in a bottom sheet.

DatePicker.purpose: A month of days to pick one from, with the month's name between previous and next buttons.

Dialog.purpose: Core's `Dialog`, shown as a bottom sheet by default: the shape phones use for a modal task (`variant="center"` for a card in the middle).

Drawer.purpose: A panel that slides in from one edge and floats a step in from it, clear of the notch and the home indicator.

Dropdown.purpose: The bordered surface a menu's Options sit on; DropdownWrapper places it under its trigger

DropdownWrapper.purpose: A trigger that opens a menu of Options under it (or above when there is no room): row actions, an account menu

Feedback.purpose: An inline alert tinted by its tone, announced when it appears.

Field.purpose: A label, a hint and an error around one control, wired together.

Fieldset.purpose: A titled section of a form whose fields are laid out by a `Form` grid, so it takes the same `density`, `columns` and `span`.

Flex.purpose: A row by default, as on the web (React Native's `View` is a column).

Form.purpose: Spacing, columns and grouping for a set of fields, a size for all of them, and the submit state a `SubmitButton` shows.

FormErrorSummary.purpose: Every error in a form in one alert, after a failed submit.

Grid.purpose: Children in equal columns, `gap` apart both ways.

Heading.purpose: A heading, heading-strong-l by default and announced as a header

Icon.purpose: One of the built-in icons, or one registered with `IconProvider`.

IconButton.purpose: A square button holding one icon.

IconProvider.purpose: Adds to or replaces the built-in icons, by name.

InfoTip.purpose: A small info icon that shows a sentence of context.

InlineCode.purpose: Code in a sentence, in the code font on a weak tint with a hairline border.

Input.purpose: A bordered field with a floating label, error and description lines.

Kbd.purpose: A key on a keyboard, for a shortcut on a tablet or desktop.

LineChart.purpose: A line per series over the rows of `data`, with the area under it filled by `variant`, on a card with a header, a legend and tick labels.

List.purpose: A column of `ListItem`s with bullets, or numbers when `as="ol"`.

ListItem.purpose: One line of a `List`, its marker in `neutral-on-background-weak`.

LogoSpinner.purpose: The four tiles of the Once UI mark, moving.

Markdown.purpose: Markdown rendered with Once UI, as core's MDX components render it on the web: headings, body text, links, inline code, `CodeBlock`, `BlockQuote` style quotes, `List`, `Table`, `Media` and `Line`.

Mascot.purpose: An animated companion for an assistant, one soft, single-color shape with eyes.

Media.purpose: A clipped box at `aspectRatio` with a skeleton until the image loads.

NavGroup.purpose: A collapsible set of NavItems, indented behind a rail.

NavItem.purpose: One row of navigation that knows whether it is the current page.

NavSection.purpose: A titled block of rows, its heading small and dim.

NumberInput.purpose: An `Input` for a number, with − and + buttons that step it by `step` within `min` and `max`.

OTPInput.purpose: One field per digit of a one-time code.

Option.purpose: One row of a list to pick from.

Pagination.purpose: Previous and next, the first and last pages, the pages around the current one, and an ellipsis for the rest.

PasswordInput.purpose: An `Input` that hides what is typed, with an eye button that shows it.

ProgressBar.purpose: A rounded track that fills to `value`, with the value as a label.

RadioButton.purpose: A 20pt circle, brand-filled with a dot when checked.

RadioGroup.purpose: One choice out of `options`, with an optional group label.

RangeSlider.purpose: Two thumbs on one track, selecting a `[start, end]` range, such as a price filter.

Reaction.purpose: One reaction at a fixed size with its own gesture.

Reactions.purpose: The row under a post, a comment or a message.

Row.purpose: Horizontal flex layout — default direction row

Scroller.purpose: Flex props lay out the content (`gap`, `padding`, `safeArea` for the home indicator), size props size the view.

SegmentedControl.purpose: A row of toggle buttons where one is selected.

Select.purpose: An `Input`-styled field that opens its options in a bottom sheet.

Skeleton.purpose: A pulsing placeholder while content loads.

Spinner.purpose: Rotating loader for async and streaming states

StatusIndicator.purpose: Small coloured status dot (online, error, warning) by colour scheme

SubmitButton.purpose: A `Button` that submits the `Form` around it (React Native has no form element) and shows a spinner, ignoring taps, while the submit runs, so a double tap sends one request.

Switch.purpose: A 40×24 track with a sliding knob, and an optional label.

Tab.purpose: One tab: a `ToggleButton` with the `tab` role, so it takes every ToggleButton prop.

TabList.purpose: The row (a column when `vertical`) of tabs.

TabPanel.purpose: The content for one tab, labelled by its tab for screen readers.

Table.purpose: Headers and rows as data, with search, sort, row taps, row actions, loading and empty states, and pages.

Tabs.purpose: One `TabList` of `Tab`s and a `TabPanel` per tab, matched by `value`.

Tag.purpose: A label, an announcement pill, or a toggle with an optional remove button.

Text.purpose: Body, label and display text with variant, weight and colour tokens

ThemeProvider.purpose: Root provider: core's style options with core's defaults (theme, brand, neutral, solid, border, scaling…), plus fonts and the screen's safe-area insets

Timeline.purpose: Steps joined by a line, each with a dot coloured by its state.

Toast.purpose: A short message on a surface card that hides itself.

ToastProvider.purpose: Shows toasts stacked at the bottom of the screen, newest last.

ToggleButton.purpose: A quiet button that stays highlighted while `selected`.

Tooltip.purpose: The small surface bubble a hint is drawn in; it shows nothing on its own (InfoTip shows a tip on press)

User.purpose: An avatar with a name, an optional tag and a subline, as in a list of people.

WorkingIndicator.purpose: Says an assistant is working, with the moving mark and a playful verb that changes every few seconds: "Imagining…", "Noodling…", "Kerning…".
